summary: Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index ETF filed an 8-K reporting routine operational agreements: a Third Amendment to Sponsor Agreement allowing staking of crypto assets, an Authorized Participant Agreement with Marex Capital Markets Inc., a Master Purchase and Sale Agreement for Digital Assets with JSCT LLC for principal-to-principal transactions, and a Sixth Amended and Restated Trust Agreement to enable these activities. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. These are normal-course administrative and counterparty arrangements. No deal terms or financial metrics are stated. No regulatory clock or risk-arb angle applies. The filing is a standard current report of material agreements and trust amendments, not a special situation.
